current_assessment.assessment: A restricted actual-effect-grounded account is excluded by an explicit strict-priority and giving-to-fact bridge. Bare common-source or common-act descriptions cannot account for an asymmetric rank under the explicit symmetry-completeness condition; equality of realizers collapses modes only with injectivity. These constraints apply equally to the personal account. Primitive intrinsic formal/dispositional differentiation and determinate intentional content both remain positive options. The restored matched interpretations add a source-nature maker, all-world mode/rank availability, positive explanatory paths, scoped absence/presence of cognitive dependence, and rank-sensitive production. They demonstrate those formal commitments jointly, not non-composition, exhaustive mind-independence, objective-value warrant or metaphysical possibility. Constructed structural parity is not evidence of equal overall metaphysical warrant. A4 is therefore an elaborated candidate, neither defeated nor established as genuinely metaphysically coherent; simple intellect is not exempted. No cognition or pure-perfection premise is established. The nature/mode truth equalities reduce definitionally for any supplied table; the absence of cognition-to-mode/rank paths follows from false cognition plus factivity. The added formal content is the selected positive source-nature graph and rank-sensitive giving, not an independent derivation of profile determination or mind-independence.
